codeReview.summary: The fix correctly restores active-pane highlighting for visible/all-tile queries when a workspace remembers a stale column index, but it leaves the underlying workspace focus index invalid. Because `Workspace::target_offset_for_active_with_strategy` still reads `self.columns[self.active_column_idx]` strictly, the same stale-focus state can still break active-column viewport targeting after cleanup/focus-restoration flows.

issues.description: `active_pane_id()` now falls back to the last surviving column when `active_column_idx` is stale, but `target_offset_for_active_with_strategy()` still returns `0.0` whenever `self.columns.get(self.active_column_idx)` fails. That leaves the workspace in an internally inconsistent state: visible/all-tile highlighting reports an active pane while viewport targeting behaves as if there were no active column. The new regression only checks highlighting and explicitly allows the stale index to persist, so focus-restoration/cleanup flows can still mis-center or fail to reveal the intended active column until some later mutation repairs the index.

summary: Reviewed the mission feature metadata, worker handoff/transcript skeleton, skill instructions, and commit `b83c341fa46de0b2de582ff3b253a42826977edc`. The change fixes one symptom of stale workspace focus, but it does not restore the actual focus invariant: `active_column_idx` may remain out of range, and other code paths such as active-column viewport targeting still treat the workspace as unfocused.
